title: The 84-Month Car Loan Trap
hook_text: EXTENDING YOUR CAR LOAN DOUBLES THE INTEREST

beats.say: Spreading a car loan across 84 months looks like a smart monthly discount. It isn't.
beats.visual: A sleek modern car parked inside a dark empty concrete garage, cinematic dim lighting, low angle shot from behind

beats.say: Here is the exact math banks hide from you.
beats.visual: A wooden office desk with a heavy brass desk lamp casting a warm circle of light, no papers visible

beats.say: When you double the length of the loan, you double the total interest paid on a depreciating asset.
beats.visual: A pair of hands sliding a metal pen across a dark dark wooden surface, shallow depth of field

beats.say: The vehicle loses value the moment it leaves the lot. Meanwhile, your interest payments keep climbing.
beats.visual: Tail lights of a car fading away into a rainy city street at dusk, cinematic blur

beats.say: You end up paying thousands extra for a machine that is rusting away.
beats.visual: Close up of heavy rain drops hitting the dark hood of a parked vehicle, moody atmospheric lighting

beats.say: That extra cash could work for you instead.
beats.visual: A person counting plain stacked coins on a simple oak table, top down view, deep shadows

beats.say: For example, $100 a month invested for 30 years at 8% annual return grows to $149,036.
beats.visual: A digital clock glowing softly on a nightstand in a dark room, minimalist aesthetic

beats.say: You only put in $36,000 of your own money over that timeline.
beats.visual: A leather wallet resting on a minimalist concrete block, dramatic side lighting

beats.say: Compound interest builds wealth when you let time do the work.
beats.visual: A tall hourglass resting on a dark marble counter, sand slowly falling through the center

beats.say: A long car loan does the exact opposite. It steals your future buying power.
beats.visual: Shadows of window blinds stretching across a bare white wall in the late afternoon sun

beats.say: Keep your loan terms short and keep your cash where it grows.
beats.visual: A brass key resting on a clean wooden tabletop, dramatic overhead framing

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single bright warm light at the far end, cinematic perspective

caption: Long loans build bank accounts, not yours. Keep the term short and keep your cash. #money #personalfinance #financialliteracy #wealthbuilding #carloan
description: Exposing how extending a car loan to 84 months doubles total interest paid on a depreciating asset while robbing you of compounding returns.
first_comment: What is the longest car loan term you have ever been offered?

facts.claim: $100/month invested for 30 years at 8%/yr equals $149,036 with $36,000 principal
